title: IMWA: Iterative Model Weight Averaging benefits class-imbalanced learning
mechanism: Split training into episodes; several models trained from the same start are averaged and the average starts the next episode; complements EMA on imbalanced tasks.
adaptation: 4 parallel copies on 4 A6000s, average every 1k-2k steps across the 20k house schedule; aims at rare crack pixels and the 42 inactive cells.
min_experiment: Arm: IMWA (4 copies, 10 episodes), 3 replicates. Baseline: house single. Metric: inactive IoU and crack IoU on CV. Kill: < +0.01 on both.
evidence: R: long-tailed classification, imbalanced SSL and SSOD; +0.8 to +1.8 top-1 over strong bases vs about +0.2 for end-of-training averaging; additive with EMA; Pascal VOC SSOD AP50:95 +1.8 for Unbiased Teacher.
